content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-36. - Protested improvements.

faqs.a:
Except for sidewalks, water mains, sewers and their appurtenances, no project or other
               local improvement shall be ordered by the council in the event a majority in area
               or majority in frontage, as the case may be, of the lands to be assessed with the
               cost thereof shall by written petition protest against such local improvements.
(Code 1981, § 27-37; Ord. No. 551, § 14(F), 5-14-1964)
